scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached dead air standards twice with unannounced silent pauses of 35s and 37s while querying line databases, prompting caller chasing on both occasions.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely skipped account security verification, failing to request installation postcode, customer PIN, or security questions during the first 240 seconds or at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to personalize the call, never addressing the caller by name ('Zoey') throughout the entire 19-minute interaction.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed Empathy throughout the call, ignoring four months of speed throttling and exam stress, and offering cold corporate guideline deflections during an outburst in the final third.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never provided a restatement of the speed throttling, coursework crisis, or overbilling, jumping straight into database lookups.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent refused to take ownership of the provisioning error, refusing to escalate to tier-3 engineering or process an overcharge refund, unhelpfully telling the student to wait three weeks until the next billing cycle.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly terminated the call at turn 50 while the customer was asking whether hardware power-cycling would be required, hanging up without confirming complete resolution.

grader.scenario: Capped broadband speed restricted to 10Mbps due to legacy billing profile mismatch
grader.notes: Capped broadband speed profile mismatch call handled by Vicky. Student customer was restricted to 10Mbps on a 500Mbps plan for 4 months due to an automated XML provisioning error. Agent probed hardware LEDs well, but failed 7 criteria: Dead Air (two 30s+ gaps), Verified (skipped completely), Personalized (caller never named), Empathy (unhandled outbursts including final third), Paraphrasing (no restatement), Ownership (refused escalation/refund), and Confirmed Resolved (cut off caller at closing).
